findings.title: 12 model(s) flagged cui_capable:false are served
findings.detail: The instance declares deployment_type="government", classification_level="?". Ask Sage docs: non-CUI models "are not found on all instances... If you are on a CUI-compliant instance, these models will not be available."

findings.title: Government/CUI deployment runs the unrestricted default model list
findings.detail: vars.js sets deployment_type="government" but neither REACT_APP_force_gov_models, REACT_APP_force_dod_models nor REACT_APP_allowed_models, so the web app offers its default list.

findings.title: The web app's active list ("default") offers 5 non-CUI model(s)
findings.detail: These appear in the chat UI model picker for this deployment.

findings.title: 34 served model(s) are outside the "gov (reference: deployment is government-like but no list is forced)" allow-list
findings.detail: get-models is unauthenticated and, per Ask Sage docs, not filtered per environment; the server may still refuse these per account. Listed is not proof of callable.

findings.title: 11 "-com" (commercial hosting / provider-direct) model(s) served on a government-like deployment
1 alias(es) map to more than one model
openai/v1/models lists 2 id(s) backed by a non-CUI model
openai/v1/models lists 1 id(s) that resolve to a "-com" model on a government-like deployment
Model suffixes with no published definition (-ts, -sec)
findings.detail: Treat their data handling as unknown until Ask Sage defines them.

findings.title: anthropic/v1/models lists 8 id(s) that are neither a get-models id nor an alias
findings.detail: The server maps these to a backing model per environment (per the BYOK docs, e.g. Commercial -> provider-direct "-com", Gov/DoD -> Vertex). Which backend, and so which hosting and CUI status, cannot be determined from public data: send exact get-models ids instead.

findings.title: anthropic/v1/models: 5 public id(s) resolve through aliases
2 id(s) in the web app lists are not served
10 model(s) have no token_conversion_rate
findings.detail: The extension must treat these as "unpriced" (plan §3.1).
